title: acid rave breaks, then the clap pairs fold the floor
story: Riton & Kah-Lo at 123: the groove drives the surface (kick on ola_alto, snare on filo and brightness, contrast opening each half-bar) until the drums drop out at 4631. The break keeps a stroke on every beat, the flow drifts slowly and brightness settles. Three clap pairs a beat apart (4874/4889, 4953/4968, 5126/5141) fold the surface twice each, flashing harder each pair and reversing the flow in turn; then the picture settles into a steady, slowly turning state for the post-roll.
